brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.requirement: Planter of four cells: four hex bases, each cell holding a bin for soil
requirements.evidence: Four Hex base Full pieces at cells (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (3,0) on level 0, in a straight row.

requirements.requirement: A water pipe run passes through the bases so it feeds every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 (irrigation mode, the default) enters at (0,0) from edge 3 and passes through (1,0), (2,0), (3,0). check_build meshClash is clear. Pipe is a non-potable irrigation run per the BOM note; not verified for water use.

requirements.requirement: Each of the four cells has a bin (soil container) to hold the plant
requirements.evidence: Four Bin third depth (hex-bin-third) parts, one in each of the four cells. Third depth is the only bin the pipe-through cells accept. No soil or plants added yet.

finish.summary: Built a row of four hex bases with an irrigation pipe run passing through all four cells, and a third-depth bin in each cell. Check_build reports meshClash clear with only an info note about open cap faces. The brief did not ask for plants or soil, so none were added. Pipe is irrigation mode, not potable; the configurator cannot judge water suitability or material safety.

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
